headline: Bring AirGradient air quality readings into Home Assistant
intro: Connect AirGradient indoor, outdoor, or portable monitors to fetch device data, including measures such as PM2.5, CO2, TVOCs, and NOx. Home Assistant regularly communicates with the device over the local network to check for changes.
highlights: Fetch air quality data from AirGradient devices, with available sensors depending on model and features
Use local polling as Home Assistant regularly communicates with the device for updates
Set Configuration source to Local for supported settings, calibration, and test buttons

flow.title: From AirGradient monitor to Home Assistant
stages: Add AirGradient from Settings → Devices & services
Enter the device host in the user configuration step
Review available sensor and configuration entities
